name: 46615 · South Bend, IN
findings: ZIP 46615 (South Bend) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Union organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46615 (South Bend) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
